purpose: Verify authorized user can open dedicated course workspace
preconditions: CourseWorkspace exists; User enrolled as Student

purpose: Verify course home displays syllabus, schedule, instructors, and TAs
preconditions: CourseWorkspace populated with syllabus, schedule, and instructor/TA memberships
action_or_input: Retrieve workspace and related memberships for course
expected_result: Syllabus, schedule, and memberships contain instructor and TA roles

purpose: Verify unenrolled user access restriction to course workspace
preconditions: CourseWorkspace exists; User has no membership

purpose: Verify Faculty can configure and update course details
preconditions: User is assigned Faculty instructor for course
action_or_input: Faculty updates syllabus and schedule fields

purpose: Verify Student cannot modify course workspace details
preconditions: User is enrolled Student
action_or_input: Student invokes API or service to update course details

purpose: Verify Faculty can upload supported material types (file, link, note)
preconditions: Course exists; User is Faculty
action_or_input: Faculty creates materials with material_type in [file, link, note]

purpose: Verify Faculty can organize materials into modules/sections
preconditions: Course exists; User is Faculty

purpose: Verify Faculty can schedule future material release
preconditions: Course exists; User is Faculty
action_or_input: Faculty uploads material with is_scheduled=True and future release date
expected_result: CourseMaterial status is scheduled and scheduled_release_at is set

purpose: Verify scheduled material visibility rule when release date reached
preconditions: CourseMaterial has status=scheduled and scheduled_release_at <= now

purpose: Verify Student read-only material access and unpublished material hidden
preconditions: Course has published and draft materials; User is Student
expected_result: Only published materials returned; draft/scheduled hidden

purpose: Verify TA read-only material access
preconditions: Published course material exists; User is TA

purpose: Verify Observer read-only material access
preconditions: Published course material exists; User is Observer
expected_result: Published materials returned; write actions prohibited

purpose: Verify Faculty can post course announcement
preconditions: Course exists; User is Faculty

purpose: Verify permitted TA can post announcement
preconditions: User is TA with can_post_announcements=True

purpose: Verify announcement timestamping and course-wide visibility
preconditions: Announcement posted in course

purpose: Verify Faculty can create assignment in draft state
preconditions: Course exists; User is Faculty
action_or_input: create_assignment with title, instructions, points, due_date

purpose: Verify assignment configuration validation (negative points rejected)
preconditions: Course exists; User is Faculty

purpose: Verify draft assignment remains hidden from students
preconditions: Assignment has status=draft; User is Student
expected_result: Draft assignment is omitted from query results

purpose: Verify Faculty can publish assignment immediately
preconditions: Assignment has status=draft; User is Faculty
expected_result: Assignment status becomes available and published_at is set

purpose: Verify scheduled assignment hidden from students before release date
preconditions: Assignment status=scheduled with release_date in future
expected_result: Scheduled assignment is omitted from available list

purpose: Verify Student can view available assignment
preconditions: Assignment has status=available; User is Student
expected_result: Available assignment is included in student list

purpose: Verify Student can submit assignment with matching submission type
preconditions: Assignment is available with submission_type=text; User is enrolled Student

purpose: Verify submission type mismatch is rejected
preconditions: Assignment configured for file submission; User submits text
action_or_input: submit_assignment with submission_type=text on file assignment

purpose: Verify Student can view own submission history and status
preconditions: StudentSubmission exists for Student 1
expected_result: Submission returned with content and submitted_at

purpose: Verify Faculty can grade student submission with score and feedback
preconditions: StudentSubmission exists; User is Faculty
action_or_input: grade_submission with valid points and feedback
expected_result: Grade created with status=draft and grader attribution

purpose: Verify TA can grade student submission with score and feedback
preconditions: StudentSubmission exists; User is TA
expected_result: Grade created with graded_by_user_id set to TA user_id

purpose: Verify draft grade remains hidden from student until release
preconditions: Grade exists with status=draft; User is evaluated Student
expected_result: Draft grade is omitted from student grades

purpose: Verify Faculty can release draft grades to students
preconditions: Draft grades exist; User is Faculty
expected_result: Grades transition to released and released_at timestamp set

purpose: Verify Student can view released grade and feedback
preconditions: Grade has status=released; User is evaluated Student
expected_result: Released grade and feedback present in student response

purpose: Verify post-release grade modification creates audit log
preconditions: Grade is released; Faculty modifies score
action_or_input: modify_released_grade with new points and reason
expected_result: Grade updated and GradeChangeLog records old/new points, user, and reason

purpose: Verify TA authoring restriction on assignments
preconditions: User is TA

purpose: Verify TA authoring restriction on course materials
preconditions: User is TA

purpose: Verify Observer restriction from viewing student submissions
preconditions: Student submissions exist; User is Observer

purpose: Verify Observer write restriction on grade evaluation
preconditions: User is Observer

purpose: Verify unenrolled user submission rejection via API endpoint
preconditions: Assignment is available; Requesting user has NO membership in course
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden or rejection due to lack of course membership
